correctness.rationale: The propagating-condition graph G_b contains all and only allowable two-digit states, and its directed cycles are exactly primitive propagating cycles. The finite range b=2..1230 is exhaustive for proving every listed least base because each has a witness within it. Two distinct exact methods (3-color functional graph traversal and zero-indegree peeling) compute all cycles at every base and independently agree on every first occurrence. The exact integer verifier was built and run, printing VERIFIED; a separate nineteen-cycle witness table was checked transition-by-transition. No infinite inference is made.

value.rationale: Remark 2.13 of Integer Dynamics explicitly motivates the least base for a propagating cycle of given length and reports only a common existential bound for all lengths <=20. A complete first-occurrence spectrum over exactly that source-motivated finite range determines the natural sharp cutoff 1230, including the substantial and nonmonotone late values (17=>1120, 18=>96, 20=>1230), rather than a toy isolated number. The exact minimality certificate is reusable as a benchmark for proposed growth bounds; it does not pretend to establish a general polynomial bound.
